تحترمين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَرِمِينَ (taḥtarimīna) /taħ.ta.ri.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# تُحْتَرَمِينَ (tuḥtaramīna) /tuħ.ta.ra.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
